_comment: Cards that exist only for the attacking-player selector test (tests/unit/combat/test_attacking_player_selector.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_pairs_watcher` is Trouble in Pairs' attack clause and `t_diplomat_watcher` is Mangara, the Diplomat's, each paying 1 life instead of a card so the count is readable off a life total.

cards.name: Test Pairs Watcher
cards.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent attacks you with two or more creatures, you gain 1 life.

abilities.text: Whenever an opponent attacks you with two or more creatures, you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Test Diplomat Watcher
cards.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures, if two or more of those creatures are attacking you and/or planeswalkers you control, you gain 1 life.

abilities.text: Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures, if two or more of those creatures are attacking you and/or planeswalkers you control, you gain 1 life.
